summary.text: Josh Carnley, a Republican, has represented District 31 in the Alabama State Senate since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Ino, Alabama, graduated from Kinston High School in 1997 and earned a degree in agricultural science from Auburn University.
He owns and is president of SanBuck Insurance and has served on the ChocPea Yellow River Watershed Authority.
